whitebox_not_evaluable.reason: tb-cotrain co-trains the encoder DURING victim finetuning (splitbench interleaves a minimax encoder update every tb_cotrain_interval steps), but only the FINAL co-trained encoder checkpoint is saved. The base sweep captures training-phase fwd wires only, so every capture was produced by an EARLIER encoder version than the saved checkpoint and no post-training/inference capture exists for which the saved checkpoint is the authoritative encoder. Evaluating these captures against the final checkpoint would silently attack with a mismatched encoder, so the cell is NOT_EVALUABLE. A future capture rig that stores per-update encoder versions (or post-training inference captures) can lift this exclusion.
